description: Complete the record: pass act, the BODY_JSON from prepare_net_independence_record UNCHANGED and the signature your wallet produced over MESSAGE_TO_SIGN. Relays to the same public door any HTTP client uses (POST /labor/net/independence/<act>, the act named by its own path); this server holds no keys and no funds, and the door checks the signature itself and keeps its own free daily limit for one connection. Free with a valid body-bound signature from the wallet that acts. A record moves no NET and holds none, and nothing is decided by it. The programs are held off until the operator switches the NET programs on; the house pays, holds and sells nothing through this tool. Nothing here reads a wallet's records back, so a repeat of the same terms is read back as already recorded and adds nothing. Cost and signer: free, no gas; signed by the person's own wallet or passkey, and the house never holds a key.
